blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 完成本節學習後，您將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 說明為何FDA將文件視為驗證的「實質證據」。
blocks.en: Explain why FDA treats documentation as the "substantive evidence" of validation.

blocks.zh: 區分Stage 1、2、3各階段對文件的不同要求層次。
blocks.en: Distinguish the different levels of documentation required in Stage 1, Stage 2 and Stage 3.

blocks.zh: 識別管轄製程驗證記錄的CGMP法規條款。
blocks.en: Identify the CGMP regulatory provisions that govern process validation records.

blocks.zh: 說明開發階段分析方法與商業放行分析方法的差異。
blocks.en: Explain the difference between analytical methods used during development and analytical methods used for commercial release.

blocks.zh: 正確定義並在法規情境中應用所有術語表條目。
blocks.en: Correctly define and apply every glossary entry in a regulatory context.

blocks.zh: 為CDMO建構完整的PPQ生命週期文件套件。
blocks.en: Build a complete PPQ lifecycle documentation package for a CDMO.

blocks.zh: VI. Documentation | 第六章：文件要求
blocks.en: VI. Documentation

blocks.zh: 為何文件是驗證的核心
blocks.en: Why Documentation Is Central to Validation

blocks.zh: FDA將文件視為驗證本身的一部分，而非僅是行政工作。其背後邏輯是：沒有文件記錄的工作，在法規上等同於沒有做過。
blocks.en: FDA regards documentation as part of validation itself, not merely administrative work. The logic is simple: work that is not documented is, from a regulatory standpoint, work that was never done.

blocks.zh: 核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principle

blocks.zh: 製程驗證跨越多年、多部門、多人員。文件是確保：
blocks.en: Process validation spans many years, many departments and many people. Documentation ensures:

blocks.zh: 知識傳承 — 開發知識不因人員異動而流失
blocks.en: Knowledge continuity — development knowledge is not lost when staff change

blocks.zh: 科學透明性 — 任何人都能理解決策依據
blocks.en: Scientific transparency — anyone can understand the basis for decisions

blocks.zh: 法規可稽核性 — FDA查廠時可追溯完整驗證歷程
blocks.en: Regulatory auditability — FDA can trace the complete validation history during an inspection

blocks.zh: 商業放行依據 — QA能做出有根據的放行決定
blocks.en: Basis for commercial release — QA can make an informed release decision

blocks.zh: 比喻：文件如同法庭證據
blocks.en: Analogy: Documentation as Courtroom Evidence

blocks.zh: 驗證就像一場法庭案件——你的製程是「被告」，FDA是「法官」。無論你的製程實際上多穩定，若無文件佐證，你就是「無罪推定」的另一面：沒有證據，沒有勝訴。
blocks.en: Validation is like a court case: your process is the "defendant" and FDA is the "judge". No matter how stable your process actually is, without documentation to back it up you have no case: no evidence, no win.

blocks.zh: 各階段CGMP文件要求強度
blocks.en: Intensity of CGMP Documentation Requirements by Stage

blocks.zh: Stage 1 — 製程設計（Process Design）
blocks.en: Stage 1 — Process Design

blocks.zh: 文件要求相對彈性。主要產出：
blocks.en: Documentation requirements are relatively flexible. Main outputs:

blocks.zh: 商業製造Master Batch Record (§ 211.186)
blocks.en: Master Batch Record for commercial manufacture (§ 211.186)

blocks.zh: 製程流程圖（Process Flow Diagrams）
blocks.en: Process flow diagrams

blocks.zh: 各規模的製程比較文件
blocks.en: Documents comparing the process at each scale

blocks.zh: 支持程序（Supporting Procedures）
blocks.en: Supporting procedures

blocks.zh: Stage 2 — 製程確認（Process Qualification）
blocks.en: Stage 2 — Process Qualification

blocks.zh: 文件要求最高，全面符合CGMP：
blocks.en: Documentation requirements are at their highest, with full CGMP compliance:

blocks.zh: PPQ Protocol（需QA事前批准）
blocks.en: PPQ protocol (requires prior QA approval)

blocks.zh: 批次製造記錄
blocks.en: Batch manufacturing records

blocks.zh: 偏差報告
blocks.en: Deviation reports

blocks.zh: PPQ Final Report（需QA批准）
blocks.en: PPQ final report (requires QA approval)

blocks.zh: Stage 3 — 持續製程驗證（CPV）
blocks.en: Stage 3 — Continued Process Verification (CPV)

blocks.zh: 文件要求持續且系統性：
blocks.en: Documentation requirements are ongoing and systematic:

blocks.zh: CPV計畫
blocks.en: CPV plan

blocks.zh: 定期統計趨勢報告
blocks.en: Periodic statistical trending reports

blocks.zh: 製程能力指數（Cpk）記錄
blocks.en: Process capability index (Cpk) records

blocks.zh: CAPA記錄（如有觸發）
blocks.en: CAPA records (if triggered)

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：病毒/雜質清除研究
blocks.en: Important Reminder: Viral/Impurity Clearance Studies

blocks.zh: 即使在小規模進行的病毒清除或雜質清除研究，同樣需要Quality Unit的監管與文件核准——不能因為是實驗室規模就降低文件標準。
blocks.en: Even viral clearance or impurity clearance studies performed at small scale still require Quality Unit oversight and documentation approval; laboratory scale is no reason to lower documentation standards.

blocks.zh: 製程流程圖：Stage 1的核心輸出文件
blocks.en: Process Flow Diagrams: The Core Stage 1 Deliverable

blocks.zh: 製程流程圖不只是「示意圖」，它是FDA期待看到的科學決策工具，展示從小試到商業規模的可比性評估。
blocks.en: A process flow diagram is more than a "schematic". It is the scientific decision-making tool FDA expects to see, demonstrating the comparability assessment from small scale to commercial scale.

blocks.zh: 完整製程流程圖應包含
blocks.en: A Complete Process Flow Diagram Should Include

blocks.zh: 單元操作（Unit Operations） — 每個步驟的順序與位置
blocks.en: Unit operations — the sequence and position of each step

blocks.zh: 監控點（Monitoring Points） — 在線、離線量測點
blocks.en: Monitoring points — online and offline measurement points

blocks.zh: 控制點（Control Points） — CPP觸發的控制行動
blocks.en: Control points — control actions triggered by CPPs

blocks.zh: 物料輸入 — 原料、輔料、加工助劑
blocks.en: Material inputs — raw materials, excipients, processing aids

blocks.zh: 中間體輸出 — 中間產品規格
blocks.en: Intermediate outputs — intermediate specifications

blocks.zh: 成品輸出 — 最終CQA要求
blocks.en: Finished product outputs — final CQA requirements

blocks.zh: 比喻：縮放比例地圖
blocks.en: Analogy: Maps at Different Scales

blocks.zh: 保留各規模（1L → 50L → 500L → 商業批）的流程圖，就像保留不同比例尺的地圖——放大看細節，縮小看格局，兩者都需要，才能向FDA說明「放大規模的可比性」。
blocks.en: Keeping the flow diagrams for each scale (1 L → 50 L → 500 L → commercial batch) is like keeping maps at different scales: zoom in for detail, zoom out for the big picture. You need both to demonstrate scale-up comparability to FDA.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填作業中，製程流程圖應涵蓋：配液 → 過濾（0.22µm） → 充填 → 壓蓋 → 滅菌（若適用），並標註每個步驟的環境監控點（EMPs）與在製品檢測點（IPCs）。
blocks.en: For aseptic filling operations, the process flow diagram should cover: compounding → filtration (0.22 µm) → filling → capping → sterilization (if applicable), with the environmental monitoring points (EMPs) and in-process control (IPC) test points marked at each step.

blocks.zh: VII. Analytical Methodology | 第七章：分析方法學
blocks.en: VII. Analytical Methodology

blocks.zh: 分析方法學：開發 vs. 商業放行的不同標準
blocks.en: Analytical Methodology: Different Standards for Development vs. Commercial Release

blocks.zh: FDA在此明確區分兩種情境下的分析方法要求，這是很多公司容易混淆的地方。
blocks.en: FDA clearly distinguishes the analytical method requirements for these two situations, a point many companies confuse.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：PPQ前方法須到位
blocks.en: Key Principle: Methods Must Be in Place Before PPQ

blocks.zh: 雖然FDA說開發階段不強制要求完整方法驗證，但實務上：進入PPQ（Stage 2）之前，所有商業放行方法必須已完成驗證。否則PPQ數據的可信度將受質疑，導致整個驗證工作失去意義。
blocks.en: Although FDA says full method validation is not mandatory during development, in practice all commercial release methods must be validated before entering PPQ (Stage 2). Otherwise the credibility of the PPQ data will be questioned, and the whole validation effort loses its meaning.

blocks.zh: 新興分析技術（PAT）
blocks.en: Emerging Analytical Technologies (PAT)

blocks.zh: FDA鼓勵採用新興分析技術（如過程分析技術PAT），特別是當這些技術能：
blocks.en: FDA encourages the use of emerging analytical technologies (such as process analytical technology, PAT), especially where they can:

blocks.zh: 提升對製程或產品的理解
blocks.en: Improve understanding of the process or product

blocks.zh: 降低品質風險
blocks.en: Reduce quality risk

blocks.zh: 提供更即時的製程控制
blocks.en: Provide more real-time process control

blocks.zh: 參見：FDA PAT Guidance (September 2004)
blocks.en: See also: FDA PAT Guidance (September 2004)

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：在製品vs.放行檢測
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: In-Process Testing vs. Release Testing

blocks.zh: 在製品檢測（IPC）：pH、滲透壓、過濾壓差——開發階段可用研究級方法
blocks.en: In-process control (IPC) testing: pH, osmolality, filter differential pressure; research-grade methods may be used during development

blocks.zh: 成品放行：效力、含量均一性、無菌——必須已完成USP/ICH驗證
blocks.en: Finished product release: potency, content uniformity, sterility; methods must already be validated per USP/ICH

blocks.zh: Validation Document Hierarchy | 驗證文件層級架構
blocks.en: Validation Document Hierarchy

blocks.zh: Validation Master Plan (VMP) | 驗證總計畫
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan (VMP)

blocks.zh: Stage 1: Process Development Report | 製程開發報告
blocks.en: Stage 1: Process Development Report

blocks.zh: Stage 2: PPQ Protocol + PPQ Report | 製程確認規程與報告
blocks.en: Stage 2: PPQ Protocol + PPQ Report

blocks.zh: Stage 3: CPV Plan + Periodic Reports | 持續製程驗證計畫與定期報告
blocks.en: Stage 3: CPV Plan + Periodic Reports

blocks.zh: 各層級文件說明
blocks.en: Description of Each Document Level

blocks.zh: 驗證總計畫（VMP）
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan (VMP)

blocks.zh: 為整個驗證生命週期設定框架。包含：驗證範圍、方法論、組織職責、時程。通常是呈交藥證申請（NDA/BLA）的核心文件之一。
blocks.en: Sets the framework for the entire validation lifecycle. It covers validation scope, methodology, organizational responsibilities and timelines. It is usually one of the core documents submitted in the marketing application (NDA/BLA).

blocks.zh: Stage 1：製程開發報告
blocks.en: Stage 1: Process Development Report

blocks.zh: 記錄所有導向商業製程設計的知識，包括：DoE研究結果、CQA/CPP識別、設計空間定義、規模放大評估。這是Stage 2的科學基礎。
blocks.en: Documents all the knowledge that led to the commercial process design, including DoE results, CQA/CPP identification, design space definition and scale-up assessment. This is the scientific basis for Stage 2.

blocks.zh: Stage 2：PPQ規程 + PPQ報告
blocks.en: Stage 2: PPQ Protocol + PPQ Report

blocks.zh:
PPQ規程：事前定義驗收標準、批次數量、統計方法，需QA批准後才能執行。
PPQ報告：記錄所有PPQ批次結果，結論是否符合驗收標準，需QA批准。
blocks.en:
PPQ protocol: predefines acceptance criteria, number of batches and statistical methods; it must be approved by QA before execution.
PPQ report: records the results of all PPQ batches and concludes whether the acceptance criteria were met; it must be approved by QA.

blocks.zh: Stage 3：CPV計畫 + 定期報告
blocks.en: Stage 3: CPV Plan + Periodic Reports

blocks.zh:
CPV計畫：定義監控指標、頻率、統計方法、觸發CAPA的條件。
定期報告：通常每季或半年一份，呈現製程能力趨勢，為持續改善提供依據。
blocks.en:
CPV plan: defines monitoring parameters, frequency, statistical methods and the conditions that trigger CAPA.
Periodic reports: usually issued quarterly or semiannually, presenting process capability trends as the basis for continual improvement.

blocks.zh: CDMO Documentation Checklist | CDMO文件查檢表
blocks.en: CDMO Documentation Checklist

blocks.zh: PPQ執行中與完成後
blocks.en: During and After PPQ Execution

blocks.zh: 執行中（During PPQ）：
blocks.en: During PPQ:

blocks.zh: 批次製造記錄（BPR）實時填寫，無事後補填
blocks.en: Batch production records (BPRs) completed in real time, with no retrospective entries

blocks.zh: 所有偏差即時記錄並開立偏差報告
blocks.en: All deviations recorded immediately and deviation reports opened

blocks.zh: OOS結果依21 CFR § 211.192調查
blocks.en: OOS results investigated per 21 CFR § 211.192

blocks.zh: 環境監測數據完整記錄
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring data fully recorded

blocks.zh: 在製品檢測結果記錄於BPR
blocks.en: In-process test results recorded in the BPR

blocks.zh: 電子記錄符合21 CFR Part 11要求（若適用）
blocks.en: Electronic records comply with 21 CFR Part 11 (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 完成後（Post-PPQ）：
blocks.en: Post-PPQ:

blocks.zh: PPQ Final Report（含統計分析）完成並由QA批准
blocks.en: PPQ final report (including statistical analysis) completed and approved by QA

blocks.zh: 所有批次放行前QA審核完成
blocks.en: QA review completed before release of all batches

blocks.zh: 與VMP的符合性確認
blocks.en: Conformance with the VMP confirmed

blocks.zh: CPV計畫啟動，Stage 3正式開始
blocks.en: CPV plan initiated; Stage 3 formally begins

blocks.zh: 任何變更啟動變更控制（Change Control）
blocks.en: Change control initiated for any change

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 電子記錄注意事項
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 Considerations for Electronic Records

blocks.zh: 若使用電子系統記錄PPQ數據，必須確保：稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）功能啟用、電子簽章符合要求、系統驗證（CSV）已完成。
blocks.en: If electronic systems are used to record PPQ data, you must ensure that the audit trail function is enabled, electronic signatures meet requirements, and computerized system validation (CSV) has been completed.

blocks.zh: Glossary — Original Text | 術語表原文
blocks.en: Glossary — Original Text

blocks.zh: 術語深度解析
blocks.en: In-Depth Analysis of the Terms

blocks.zh: 製程能力（Process Capability）
blocks.en: Process Capability

blocks.zh: 統計意涵：常以Cpk（製程能力指數）表示。Cpk ≥ 1.33 通常被視為可接受的商業製造基準。在CPV報告中，Cpk是判斷製程是否持續在管制狀態的核心指標。
blocks.en: Statistical meaning: commonly expressed as the Cpk (process capability index). A Cpk of 1.33 or higher is generally regarded as an acceptable benchmark for commercial manufacturing. In CPV reports, Cpk is the core indicator for judging whether the process remains in a state of control.

blocks.zh: 商業製造製程（Commercial Manufacturing Process）
blocks.en: Commercial Manufacturing Process

blocks.zh: 關鍵排除項：臨床試驗批（IND material）不算商業製造製程。這意味著臨床批的驗證要求可以低於商業批，但進入NDA/BLA申請後，必須提交商業製造製程的完整驗證數據。
blocks.en: Key exclusion: clinical trial batches (IND material) are not a commercial manufacturing process. This means validation requirements for clinical batches can be lower than for commercial batches, but once an NDA/BLA is filed, complete validation data for the commercial manufacturing process must be submitted.

blocks.zh: 同步放行（Concurrent Release）
blocks.en: Concurrent Release

blocks.zh: 這是一個需要謹慎使用的機制。允許在PPQ尚未全部完成前放行某些批次，但條件是：該批次已符合預定的放行標準，且放行決定基於科學依據。不建議作為常規操作。
blocks.en: This is a mechanism to be used with caution. It allows certain batches to be released before PPQ is fully complete, provided that the batch meets the predetermined release criteria and the release decision is scientifically justified. It is not recommended as routine practice.

blocks.zh: 持續製程驗證（CPV）
blocks.en: Continued Process Verification (CPV)

blocks.zh: CPV = Stage 3的正式名稱。它不是一次性活動，而是永久性監控體系。只要產品還在商業生產，CPV就必須持續運行。這也是FDA 2011年新架構的最大改變之一——驗證不再「完成」，而是持續進行。
blocks.en: CPV is the formal name for Stage 3. It is not a one-time activity but a permanent monitoring system. As long as the product remains in commercial production, CPV must keep running. This is also one of the biggest changes in FDA's 2011 framework: validation is no longer "completed" but continues indefinitely.

blocks.zh: 績效指標（Performance Indicators）
blocks.en: Performance Indicators

blocks.zh: 在CPV框架下，典型績效指標包括：批次良率、OOS率、偏差率、Cpk趨勢。這些指標需在CPV計畫中預先定義，並定期在周期報告中呈現。
blocks.en: Under the CPV framework, typical performance indicators include batch yield, OOS rate, deviation rate and Cpk trends. These indicators must be predefined in the CPV plan and presented regularly in the periodic reports.

blocks.zh: 製程設計 vs. 製程確認 vs. 製程驗證
blocks.en: Process Design vs. Process Qualification vs. Process Validation

blocks.zh: 三個易混淆的術語：
blocks.en: Three easily confused terms:

blocks.zh: 製程設計 = Stage 1，定義製程
blocks.en: Process design = Stage 1, defines the process

blocks.zh: 製程確認 = Stage 2，確認製程
blocks.en: Process qualification = Stage 2, confirms the process

blocks.zh: 製程驗證 = 三個Stage的總和，是完整概念
blocks.en: Process validation = the sum of all three stages; the complete concept

blocks.zh: 管制狀態（State of Control）
blocks.en: State of Control

blocks.zh: 這是CPV的最終目標。它不只是「產品合格」，而是「製程持續可預測」。SPC（統計製程管制）圖中，數據點在管制界限內且無特殊趨勢，才代表真正的管制狀態。
blocks.en: This is the ultimate goal of CPV. It means more than "the product meets specification"; it means "the process is consistently predictable". Only when data points on an SPC (statistical process control) chart fall within the control limits with no special trends does it represent a true state of control.

blocks.en: Three-Stage Process Validation — Complete Document Summary

blocks.zh: Bilingual Glossary — Full Reference Table | 雙語術語完整參考表
blocks.en: Bilingual Glossary — Full Reference Table

blocks.zh: All key terms from the FDA guidance and the broader process validation context. 包含FDA指引中的正式術語及製程驗證廣義背景下的核心詞彙。
blocks.en: All key terms from the FDA guidance and the broader process validation context, including the formal terms in the FDA guidance and the core vocabulary of process validation more generally.

blocks.zh: Key Message | 核心訊息
blocks.en: Key Message

blocks.zh: 文件即驗證的本質
blocks.en: Documentation Is the Essence of Validation

blocks.zh:
「沒有記錄，就是沒有做過。」
— GMP產業通行原則
blocks.en:
"If it isn't recorded, it didn't happen."
— A widely accepted principle in the GMP industry

blocks.zh: FDA 2011年製程驗證指引的核心訊息之一：文件不是行政負擔，文件就是驗證本身。從法規角度看：
blocks.en: One of the core messages of FDA's 2011 process validation guidance: documentation is not an administrative burden; documentation is validation itself. From a regulatory perspective:

blocks.zh: 沒有文件 = 驗證不存在
blocks.en: No documentation = validation does not exist

blocks.zh: 無論製程實際上有多穩定、科學工作有多嚴謹，若無法以記錄證明，在法規上等同於未執行。FDA查廠時，稽查員看的是文件，不是你的口頭描述。
blocks.en: No matter how stable the process actually is or how rigorous the scientific work, if it cannot be demonstrated by records, it is regulatorily equivalent to not having been done. During an FDA inspection, the investigator looks at documents, not at your verbal explanations.

blocks.zh: 三階段文件的邏輯鏈
blocks.en: The Logic Chain of Three-Stage Documentation

blocks.zh: Stage 1文件（開發知識）→ 成為Stage 2 PPQ設計的科學依據
blocks.en: Stage 1 documents (development knowledge) → become the scientific basis for designing Stage 2 PPQ

blocks.zh: Stage 2文件（PPQ證據）→ 成為Stage 3 CPV的基準線
blocks.en: Stage 2 documents (PPQ evidence) → become the baseline for Stage 3 CPV

blocks.zh: Stage 3文件（CPV記錄）→ 成為下一次藥證申請、變更申請的數據來源
blocks.en: Stage 3 documents (CPV records) → become the data source for the next marketing application or change submission

blocks.zh: 三個階段的文件形成閉環，缺少任何一環，整個驗證架構就不完整。
blocks.en: The documents of the three stages form a closed loop; if any link is missing, the whole validation architecture is incomplete.

blocks.zh: CDMO的文件文化建立
blocks.en: Building a Documentation Culture at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 作為CDMO，服務多個客戶的驗證專案，文件管理尤為重要：
blocks.en: As a CDMO serving multiple clients' validation projects, document management is especially important:

blocks.zh: 建立標準化文件模板（減少人為差異）
blocks.en: Establish standardized document templates (to reduce human variation)

blocks.zh: 確保文件系統符合21 CFR Part 11（電子記錄）
blocks.en: Ensure the document system complies with 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic records)

blocks.zh: 技術轉移時明確文件所有權（客戶 vs. CDMO）
blocks.en: Define document ownership (client vs. CDMO) clearly at technology transfer

blocks.zh: 定期文件培訓（防止「for training only」心態）
blocks.en: Provide regular documentation training (to prevent a "for training only" mindset)

blocks.zh: GMP ready at all times——文件隨時可接受FDA稽查
blocks.en: GMP ready at all times: documents are always ready for FDA inspection

blocks.zh: 思考練習 | Reflection
blocks.en: Reflection

blocks.zh: 如果明天FDA稽查員出現在你的設施，要求查看最近一個PPQ批次的完整文件包，你能在30分鐘內提供以下所有文件嗎？
blocks.en: If an FDA investigator showed up at your facility tomorrow and asked to see the complete document package for the most recent PPQ batch, could you provide all of the following within 30 minutes?

blocks.zh: QA事前批准的PPQ Protocol
blocks.en: PPQ protocol with prior QA approval

blocks.zh: 完整的批次製造記錄
blocks.en: Complete batch manufacturing records

blocks.zh: 所有在製品檢測數據
blocks.en: All in-process test data

blocks.zh: 偏差報告（如有）
blocks.en: Deviation reports (if any)

blocks.zh: 分析方法驗證報告
blocks.en: Analytical method validation reports

blocks.zh: 統計分析結果
blocks.en: Statistical analysis results

blocks.zh: QA批准的PPQ Final Report
blocks.en: PPQ final report approved by QA

blocks.zh: 如果答案是「不確定」，那就是你的文件管理系統需要改進的地方。
blocks.en: If the answer is "not sure", that is where your document management system needs improvement.

blocks.zh: Electronic Records & 21 CFR Part 11 | 電子記錄與法規要求
blocks.en: Electronic Records & 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: 電子記錄的CDMO實務重點
blocks.en: Key Practical Points for Electronic Records at a CDMO

blocks.zh: CSV（電腦系統驗證）
blocks.en: CSV (Computerized System Validation)

blocks.zh: 用於保存PPQ/CPV數據的任何電子系統（LIMS、MES、EBR）都必須完成CSV。驗證範疇包括：
blocks.en: Any electronic system used to store PPQ/CPV data (LIMS, MES, EBR) must have completed CSV. The validation scope includes:

blocks.zh: 使用者需求規格（URS）
blocks.en: User requirements specification (URS)

blocks.zh: 功能規格（FS）
blocks.en: Functional specification (FS)

blocks.zh: IQ / OQ / PQ（或GAMP 5等效框架）
blocks.en: IQ / OQ / PQ (or an equivalent GAMP 5 framework)

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤驗證
blocks.en: Audit trail verification

blocks.zh: 資料完整性（Data Integrity）
blocks.en: Data Integrity

blocks.zh: FDA近年查廠中，資料完整性違規是最常見的483觀察事項之一。ALCOA+ 原則必須貫穿所有記錄系統：
blocks.en: In recent years, data integrity violations have been among the most common Form 483 observations in FDA inspections. The ALCOA+ principles must run through all record systems:

blocks.zh: Attributable — 可歸屬
blocks.en: Attributable — traceable to the person who generated the data

blocks.zh: Legible — 清晰可讀
blocks.en: Legible — clear and readable

blocks.zh: Contemporaneous — 即時記錄
blocks.en: Contemporaneous — recorded at the time of the activity

blocks.zh: Original — 原始數據
blocks.en: Original — original data

blocks.zh: Accurate — 精確
blocks.en: Accurate — accurate

blocks.en: References Cited in the Guidance
